system.description:
Hardened on the Wall against the Red Waste, or walked away from it. You know what it costs to hold a line.

  • Waste-Hardened: Advantage on your first attack roll each round against creatures with the Orc ancestry tag.
  • Wall Authority: Advantage on Perception checks during watch or guard duty. Recognised authority within the Boldock military.
